narration.text: Why only 1% of shredded stars launch jets.
A star that strays too close gets pulled apart.
About half its matter stays bound and falls in.
The infalling gas flares brightly in X-rays.
By 2023, only four jetted events had been seen.
So hidden black holes reveal themselves by what they destroy.
